name: Domino Effect
look: A man in a light blue polo shirt and khaki pants kneels on a black mat, about to flick a tiny white domino. It starts a row of dominoes that grow steadily larger, ending in a giant slab taller than him, in a hallway with a brick wall.
use: Shows how something tiny sets off a huge consequence. The smallest domino gets the trivial first event, and the giant domino at the far end gets the massive outcome it eventually leads to.
slots: the small first cause (tiny domino by the man's hand)
the huge eventual consequence (giant domino at the left)
describe: little domino starts a row of ever bigger dominoes
man flicking a small domino next to a giant one
dominoes growing in size from tiny to huge
guy kneeling to tip the smallest domino in a chain reaction
small thing leads to a huge thing with dominoes
origin: A still from a domino chain reaction demonstration video, in which each domino is bigger than the one before it.
